basic_info.description: Enchanting, light-filled home situated on a tranquil, tree-lined st in the heart of Glen Park Village. Formal entry hall w/maple staircase leads to an expansive LR & DR. Cozy window seats in the two bays & handsome fireplace with French limestone surround. Updated half-bath, sleek remod kitchen w/stainless steel appliances & an intimate breakfast rm overlooking the patio & terraced garden. Upstairs, two comfortably-proportioned guest BRs offer south & west views above & beyond Glen Park. Large master BR with an elegantly remod sky-lit marble BA overlooking a beautifully landscaped & flowering terraced garden. Two car garage with interior access & extra storage/wine cellar. Close by Glen Park dining, shopping, BART & freeways. Fabulous!
